title: Rules for public-only research
rules: No personal data, in sources, claims or summaries.
No platform reached against its terms. Facebook and Instagram only through Meta's official access, never by scraping.
Every claim cites a public source, with an exact quote from it.
A legal summary says it is not legal advice.
A person decides what to do with the result.
disclaimer_text: This summary of public information is not legal advice.
decision: A person decides what to do with this result.

citation.quote: exact text from the cited source
